'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Jerry Heine DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jerry Heine]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Deck name:''' Queso Spice
* '''Username:''' quesosauce37
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
